statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The symptoms are consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10)
CPT code 93229 (Mobile cardiac telemetry) was billed
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
